Supply, Transportation, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of .... HP Variable refrigerant Volume (VRV) / variable refrigerant flow (VRF) Air Cooled Outdoor Units (ODU) suitable for cooling and heating having 100% thermetically sealed inverter type compressor and minimum 2 compressors along with 2 condensing fans above 14 / 18 HP Modules, Microprocessor based controller, Side / Top Discharge type condensing units with R-410 A refrigerant, vibration isolators with suitable foundation etc., complete as required. The outdoor unit shall deliver the rated capacity at AHRI conditions and work even at 50 ° centigrade ambient temperature without tripping. The unit shall be suitable to work on 430 V +/- 10%, 3 phase 50 Hz AC Power supply etc., complete finished item of work including comprehensive maintenance of units during the defect liability period. Makes: Blue star / Hitachi / Daikin/ Mitsubishi Electric or equivalent models approved by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Supply of ..... TR nominal capacity 4way- Cassette type VRV / VRF IDU. The units shall be powder coated galvanized steel housing equipped with pre filter, fan section, coil section, with inbuilt Condensate drain pump kit, etc. The body shall be light in weight and shall be able to suspend from four corners. The fan shall be mounted directly on motor shaft having supported from housing, statically and dynamically balanced and direct driven type. Makes: Blue star / Hitachi / Daikin/ Mitsubishi Electric or equivalent models approved by the Engineer-in-Charge.
